title: Figma Professional to self-hosted Penpot
summary: Penpot is the only design tool where open file format and open source are the same decision, and the seat math is where Figma charges most.

you_lose: Figma's plugin ecosystem, which is years ahead of anyone's
Auto-layout and some of the newer prototyping interactions behave differently
Figma AI — Penpot has AI in cloud offerings, not in the self-hosted build
you_gain: No seat taxonomy: no Full/Dev/Collab split to manage, everyone edits
SVG-native — files are web standards, not a proprietary format
MPL-2.0, and Penpot is the only design tool the EU has invested in as public infrastructure

caveats: Penpot is genuinely close on UI but not identical. Auto-layout, variant behaviour and some keyboard muscle memory differ; budget a re-learning week for a design-heavy team.
Importing Figma files works file-by-file via SVG/PDF rather than a full-workspace importer. The 12-hour estimate assumes a 6-seat team's active projects, not every historical draft.
Penpot self-hosted needs 4 GB RAM minimum and is heavier on disk than the design work itself suggests — the render pipeline and Postgres dominate.
